words.enExample: Despite the setbacks, the team persisted with the original plan.
words.zhExample: 尽管屡遭挫折，团队仍坚持原来的计划。
words.note: 💡 per-（贯穿）+ sist（站立）→ 一直站着不退；常见搭配 persist in / persist with；适合描述「面对困难仍坚持推进项目」的韧性。

words.meaning: 反应迅速的，积极响应的
words.enExample: A responsive manager builds trust faster with the client.
words.zhExample: 反应迅速的经理能更快和客户建立信任。
words.note: 💡 response（回应）+ -ive → 反应快的；常见搭配 responsive to / customer-responsive；面试谈「对客户反馈响应迅速」很加分。

words.meaning: 暂定的，试探性的，犹豫的
words.enExample: We've set a tentative date for the kick-off meeting next Monday.
words.zhExample: 我们把启动会的日期暂定在下周一。
words.note: 💡 tent（尝试）+ -ative → 试探性的、未定的；常见搭配 tentative plan / tentative date；常用于「tentative 排期」等商务初稿沟通。

words.enExample: New hires will undergo a two-week onboarding training.
words.zhExample: 新员工将接受为期两周的入职培训。
words.note: 💡 under-（在…下）+ go（走）→ 经历过程；常见搭配 undergo training / undergo change；适合描述「员工经历培训或公司转型」。

words.enExample: Thanks for your help — likewise, let me know if you need anything.
words.zhExample: 谢谢你的帮助——同样，需要什么也尽管告诉我。
words.note: 💡 like（像）+ wise（方式）→ 同样地；常见搭配 yours likewise / and likewise；邮件结尾「祝好」或表示「同感」时简洁得体。

essay.title: The Long Way Around
essay.author: 佚名
paragraphs: The old map on my wall still shows the river we used to fear, the one that once made us turn back. Years later I learned the bridge had been rebuilt, but by then I had grown fond of the longer road. Some mornings the detour is not a mistake but a quiet invitation to see the world sideways.

We are taught early that the shortest distance is always best, that efficiency is a kind of virtue. Yet the path that bends teaches more than the one that runs straight. I have met my truest friends at a kitchen table meant only for a quick coffee, and found my calmest thoughts on a train that was supposed to be a faster one.

There is a wisdom in wandering that planners never capture. The garden behind the bakery, the song hummed by a stranger, the hill you climb only because the sign pointed the other way — these are the gifts of going around. What looks like delay is often the moment life finally has room to speak to you.

So I have stopped apologizing for the roads I take slowly. The scenic route home, the book read twice, the conversation that refuses to end — none of it was wasted time. To arrive by the long way is to arrive with a fuller heart, carrying stories and small wonders the straight line could never have given me.

Perhaps the point was never the destination, nor the clock that measured it with such impatience. It was the unhurried turning, the quiet willingness to be late and unlost. When I look back, the long way around was the road that took me — gently, and without any hurry — into the person I was slowly becoming.
translations: 墙上那张旧地图仍标示着我们曾经害怕的河流，那条曾让我们掉头的河。多年后我才知道桥早已重建，但那时我已爱上了那条更长的路。有些清晨，绕远并非错误，而是一份安静的邀约，让你换个角度看见世界。
我们从小被教导，最短的距离总是最好，效率仿佛是一种美德。然而弯路教会我们的，比直路更多。我那些最真挚的朋友，相识于本只想匆匆喝杯咖啡的厨房桌旁；我最平静的思绪，出现在那班本应更快的列车上。
漫步之中自有规划者永远捕捉不到的智慧。面包店后的花园、陌生人哼起的歌、只因路牌指向别处而你偏要爬上的小山——这些都是绕路馈赠的礼物。看似耽搁的时刻，往往正是生活终于有空隙对你说话的瞬间。
于是我不再为自己走得慢的路道歉。回家的风景线、读了两遍的书、不愿结束的谈话——没有一样是被浪费的时光。绕远抵达，是带着更丰盈的心抵达，携着直路永远无法给予我的故事与微小惊喜。
或许重点从来不是终点，也不是丈量它的那只急躁的钟。而是那不慌不忙的回转，是甘愿迟到、甘愿迷失的安静心意。当我回望，绕远的路并非少有人走的路，而是那条温柔而不急地，把我带成了正在慢慢成为的那个人的路。

grammar.point: 现在完成时：经历与持续的状态
grammar.example: "I have grown fond of the longer road."
grammar.note: 现在完成时（have + 过去分词）用来描述从过去延续至今的状态或经历。句中 grown fond 表示「渐渐爱上」这一持续至今的心境，强调对长路的态度已发生变化并延续到现在。 举一反三：举一反三：把「have grown」换成「have come to realize」，可表达「渐渐意识到」，同样强调过程延续到现在。

grammar.example: "the hill you climb only because the sign pointed the other way — these are the gifts of going around."
grammar.note: 破折号（—）在此引出前面列举内容的总结性同位语，these 回指前文的 garden、song、hill，起到强调与收束的作用，使句式富有朗读的停顿感。 举一反三：举一反三：可用冒号或「that is」替换破折号，但破折号最自然，适合口语与美文朗读。

grammar.point: 不定式作主语与表语的对等
grammar.example: "To arrive by the long way is to arrive with a fuller heart."
grammar.note: 句中 To arrive... 作主语，to arrive... 作表语，前后两个不定式形成对等结构，表达「做 A 即意味着做 B」的深层含义，语气庄重，常用于散文式的哲理陈述。 举一反三：举一反三：可套用「To understand X is to love X」的句式，把抽象道理讲得凝练有力。

vocab.enExample: We took a scenic detour through the hills.
vocab.zhExample: 我们沿着山间风景线绕了远路。
vocab.note: 用法：指为避开障碍或纯为欣赏风景而绕行的路线

vocab.enExample: She likes to wander along the quiet river.
vocab.zhExample: 她喜欢沿着安静的河边漫步。
vocab.note: 用法：强调无明确目的、随性而行

vocab.enExample: The scenic route home took an extra hour.
vocab.zhExample: 回家的风景线多花了一个小时。
vocab.note: 用法：形容沿途或地点景色宜人

vocab.enExample: He spoke in his usual unhurried way.
vocab.zhExample: 他仍以一贯从容的语调说话。
vocab.note: 用法：形容节奏舒缓、不受时间逼迫的状态

vocab.enExample: There is a quiet wisdom in taking the long way.
vocab.zhExample: 绕远而行中藏着一种安静的智慧。
vocab.note: 用法：可指经验沉淀出的判断力

vocab.enExample: The small delay gave us time to breathe.
vocab.zhExample: 这小小的耽搁让我们得以喘息。
vocab.note: 用法：既可作名词也可作动词，指时间上的推迟

vocab.enExample: I grew fond of the longer road home.
vocab.zhExample: 我渐渐爱上了那条更长的回家路。
vocab.note: 用法：常用于 be fond of，表达对人或事的偏爱

vocab.enExample: The path took me gently toward who I am.
vocab.zhExample: 这条路温柔地把我带向如今的自己。
vocab.note: 用法：形容态度、动作或变化柔和而不突兀
